name: Migmanychion
isnote: Described as a maniraptoran with a mix of hand features (Wang et al. 2023); its position within Maniraptora is not resolved.
sum: Maniraptoran from the Early Cretaceous Longjiang Formation of Shandong, China, known from an incomplete left forelimb.
holotype: LY 2022JZ3001, an incomplete left forelimb, Longjiang Formation, Shandong Laiyang Cretaceous National Geological Park, China.
material: Only the holotype; a pelvis and hind limb of similar size from the same site were not referred to it.
biology: Its name, "claw mixture", refers to the combination of features in its hand claws.
author: Wang et al. 2023

sources.text: X. Wang, A. Cau, and Z. Wang, K. Yu, W. Wu, Y. Wang, Y. Liu. 2023. A new theropod dinosaur from the Lower Cretaceous Longjiang Formation of Inner Mongolia (China). Cretaceous Research 151:105605
